### TB incidence per 100k for Kenya

```{r message=FALSE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
tb <- read_csv("data/TB_burden_countries_2025-07-22.csv")
tb |>
  filter(iso3 == "KEN") |>
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=e_inc_100k)) +
    geom_col()
```

### Explanation

The incidence of TB in Kenya is improving.
